quote: We formulate the task as open-domain QA: given a question, a model predicts an answer without any pre-given ground-truth paragraph.
We evaluate ten large LMs ... on the open-domain question answering (QA) task in a zero-or few-shot prompting manner.
We evaluate LMs' ability to memorize factual knowledge through closed-book QA tasks with few-shot samples.
Metrics: accuracy. We mark a prediction as correct if any substring of the prediction is an exact match of any of the gold answers.
